name: How do I choose the right contractor for my detached ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my detached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience with ADU projects, checking their licensing and insurance, and reviewing their portfolio and client testimonials. Look for a contractor who communicates clearly, understands local regulations, and provides detailed, transparent proposals. A good contractor will also help navigate the design and permitting stages effectively. We encourage potential clients to compare our comprehensive approach and proven track record.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor by checking their ADU experience, licensing, portfolio, communication, and local regulatory knowledge. Ensure they offer transparent proposals.
